notes.title: New content and mechanics!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone thanks for playing 'Flinch' and giving us feedback! 

For the first major update we have made several major improvements for the game. We received feedback from players and the general consensus was simple: less tasks more monsters! We heard you and removed task books from the latest build. We want people to explore the environment and interact with the surroundings - not do busy work! 

We also added an enemy for you to avoid! Do your best to hide from it!  Our developers have had to start wearing diapers because this game freaks us out!!!

'Flinch' is still in early access so please continue to give us feedback! We hope to introduce even more new and innovative ways to make you [i]flinch[/i] in our next update. Have fun!
